entry.title: New: Bill 193 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 24, ARTICLE 10, DIVISION 5, SECTION 24-280, SCHEDULE 28 OF THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO NO PARKING AT ANY TIME

Prohibits parking at any time alongside Kaiminani Drive in North Kona at the following locations: (1) on the south side of Waikane Place from a point 51 feet southeast of Waikane Place extending 399 feet northwest

Latest action: Council: Bill 193 passes second & final reading - 9/17/2024
